title: cc-connect Health
description: cc-connect container and bridge health. Tracks container state, turn latency, Claude response success rate, token refresh status, and active sessions. Cross-reference with reviews: docs/infra/reviews/bridge-hooks-C2.md, docs/infra/reviews/bridge-ck-ingestion-A2.md

panels.title: Messages Over Time
panels.description: CC-connect messages by event_type over time. Sources: cc.message_log table (review A1-A3).

targets.query:
SELECT
  $__timeGroup(event_time, '$__interval') AS time,
  event_type,
  count() AS count
FROM cc.message_log
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
GROUP BY time, event_type
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Turn Duration (P50/P90/P99)
panels.description: Response latency percentiles for turn_complete events. High P99 (>30s sustained) indicates Claude processing issues.

targets.query:
SELECT
  $__timeGroup(event_time, '$__interval') AS time,
  quantile(0.50)(turn_duration) AS p50
FROM cc.message_log
WHERE event_type = 'message_sent'
  AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  $__timeGroup(event_time, '$__interval') AS time,
  quantile(0.90)(turn_duration) AS p90
FROM cc.message_log
WHERE event_type = 'message_sent'
  AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  $__timeGroup(event_time, '$__interval') AS time,
  quantile(0.99)(turn_duration) AS p99
FROM cc.message_log
WHERE event_type = 'message_sent'
  AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: User Activity (Top-N)
panels.description: Most active users by message count. Helps identify heavy users and potential abuse patterns.

targets.query:
SELECT
  sender_id,
  count() AS msg_count
FROM cc.message_log
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
GROUP BY sender_id
ORDER BY msg_count DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Token Consumption
panels.description: Input and output token consumption over time. Only message_sent events carry token data.

targets.query:
SELECT
  toStartOfHour(event_time) AS time,
  'input' AS direction,
  sum(input_tokens) AS tokens
FROM cc.message_log
WHERE event_type = 'message_sent'
  AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  toStartOfHour(event_time) AS time,
  'output' AS direction,
  sum(output_tokens) AS tokens
FROM cc.message_log
WHERE event_type = 'message_sent'
  AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Recent Messages
panels.description: Most recent 50 messages. Shows content_text truncated for readability.

targets.query:
SELECT
  event_time,
  event_type,
  sender_id,
  content_len,
  content_text,
  has_images,
  input_tokens,
  output_tokens
FROM cc.message_log
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
ORDER BY event_time DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Bridge Error Rate
panels.description: Error rate from bridge message processing. High rates suggest cc-connect or Claude issues.

targets.query:
SELECT
  $__timeGroup(event_time, '$__interval') AS time,
  countIf(event_type = 'message_error') * 100.0 / count() AS error_pct
FROM cc.message_log
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Active Sessions
panels.description: Sessions active in the last 30 minutes

targets.query: SELECT count(DISTINCT session) FROM cc.message_log WHERE event_time > now() - 1800
SELECT count() FROM cc.message_log WHERE event_time > today()
